status: AIE AMEND: retain each stated option/factor setting with its complete attributed source and native period; generated quality UNMEASURED

changes.old: Labels propose a binding; they do not verify it.
changes.replacement: Labels propose a binding; they do not verify it. For each explicitly stated cost or other setting of a particular option/factor, add its own statement entry, naming that option and the factor it sets. Retain the complete attributed source sentence, figure/form, unit, reference, conditions and period exactly as stated; distinguish per-year amounts, totals over the stated period and one-off costs. Never fold several options’ figures into one entry, infer a missing period or allocation, annualise a total, or treat a shared budget/limit as an option’s actual setting.
